description: Synthetic-but-realistic gaming social media posts with labeled engagement outcomes. Used by Tests 2 and 3 of the Viral or Fail eval suite.

posts.content:
EG winning Champions 2025 was the most underrated moment in Valorant esports history and people still don't talk about it enough.

Demon1 carried that grand final on a level we won't see again until at least Champions '26. The map veto into Bind alone deserves a documentary.
posts.label: viral
posts.notes: Hot take + esports nostalgia + named callout (Demon1) drove QRTs from competing fanbases.

posts.content:
POV: you're watching the GTA 6 trailer for the first time *audio: dramatic strings + 'I'm gonna cry'*

[ON SCREEN]: face cam reaction layered over the trailer's beach scene, cuts to player typing 'this is real?' in chat, then montage of pre-orders being added to cart.

Caption: ok but Lucia is everything 😭 #GTA6 #GTAVI #Rockstar #FYP #gamingtok
posts.label: viral
posts.notes: Reaction format + universal hype topic + trending audio hit every FYP signal at once. The 'real?' beat is the share trigger.

posts.content: $650 for the Steam Deck OLED is genuinely the best price-to-performance deal in handheld gaming right now. ROG Ally users seething.
posts.label: decent
posts.notes: Solid take, mild bait at the end pulls some QRTs, but no real polarisation. Decent reach inside the handheld niche.

posts.content:
*audio: 'and just like that' from SATC*

[ON SCREEN]: 'me saving 200 pulls for Mavuika' → cuts to 50/50 lost to Keqing → final shot of empty primogem counter

Caption: 6 months of saving for THIS bro 💀 #genshinimpact #50fail #mavuika #gachatok
posts.label: decent
posts.notes: Hits the gacha-pain-tok niche perfectly but doesn't break out — the audio is cooling and the meme is well-trod.

posts.content:
TITLE: I Played Silksong For 100 Hours So You Don't Have To (It's Better Than Hollow Knight)
THUMBNAIL: Hornet mid-dash with a red 'BETTER?' arrow pointing at her, split-screen with Knight on the left looking diminished. Bold yellow border.
STRUCTURE: cold open with the hardest boss fight (30s hook) → 'why the wait was worth it' → 3-act breakdown of combat / world / story → final verdict at 11:30.
posts.label: decent
posts.notes: Strong title curiosity gap and on-topic for the indie audience, but the '100 hours' framing is overdone in the niche.

posts.content:
CAROUSEL — 7 slides:
1) 'Everything Xbox just announced' over a stylised showcase logo
2) Fable reveal screenshot + release window
3) Perfect Dark gameplay still + 'Q4 2026'
4) Indiana Jones still
5) Game Pass day-one list
6) Hardware refresh hint
7) 'Save this for later → '

Caption: Xbox is cooking again 🍳 swipe through every announcement. Which one are you most hyped for?
posts.label: decent
posts.notes: Carousel format works, but 'Save for later' calls feel formulaic and the topic was saturated within 30 minutes of the showcase.

posts.content: Honestly the Microsoft acquisition of Activision Blizzard has been mostly fine for consumers so far. Game Pass got better. Not sure why people were so worried.
posts.label: flop
posts.notes: Lukewarm centrist take on a topic that needs heat to travel. No QRT bait, no novelty, dies in the first batch.

posts.content:
[ON SCREEN]: '5 games to play this weekend' over a stock background

Voiceover lists: Cyberpunk 2077, Baldur's Gate 3, Elden Ring, Hades, Stardew Valley.

Caption: which one are you playing? #gaming #games #weekend
posts.label: flop
posts.notes: Generic listicle, no hook, no audio strategy, hashtags are too broad. The FYP shows it to ~200 people and stops.

posts.content:
TITLE: Pentiment Was Actually Important And Here's Why
THUMBNAIL: a screenshot of the game's medieval art with the title text in plain white sans-serif.
STRUCTURE: 2-minute intro about historical RPGs → why the game flopped commercially → the design lessons → why it matters now.
posts.label: flop
posts.notes: Niche topic, weak thumbnail, vague title. Engagement rate from the viewers it does reach is healthy — but the algorithm never serves it widely.

posts.content: Concord shutting down is genuinely sad. The hero designs were creative and the gunplay was tight — y'all just refused to give it a fair shot because the marketing was bad.
posts.label: outlier
posts.notes: Got ratio'd into orbit. Reach is huge because the algorithm sees engagement velocity, but the like:reply ratio (1:7.5) is a community pile-on. Tests whether the Simulator can tell viral reach apart from positive reception.
